devtools.description: Choose your preferred IDE, terminal, and CLI for working with Aperant worktrees
devtools.whyConfigureDescription: When Aperant builds features in isolated worktrees, you can open them directly in your preferred IDE or terminal to test and review changes.

kuzuNotice.description: LadybugDB uses an embedded database - no Docker required. The database will be created when you first use memory features.

info.title: What is Graphiti?
info.description: Graphiti is an intelligent memory layer that helps Aperant remember context across sessions. It uses a knowledge graph to store discoveries, patterns, and insights about your codebase.
info.benefit2: Better understanding of your codebase over time
info.benefit4: No Docker required - uses embedded database

firstSpec.title: Create Your First Task
firstSpec.subtitle: Describe what you want to build and let Aperant handle the rest

opened.title: Task Creator Opened
opened.description: Great! You can create your first task now or continue with the wizard. You can always create tasks later from the main dashboard.

descriptive.title: Be Descriptive
descriptive.description: Clearly describe what you want to build. Include requirements, constraints, and expected behavior.

startSmall.title: Start Small
startSmall.description: Begin with a focused task like adding a feature or fixing a bug. Smaller tasks are easier to verify.

includeContext.title: Include Context
includeContext.description: Mention relevant files, APIs, or patterns. The more context you provide, the better the results.

letAiHelp.title: Let AI Help
letAiHelp.description: The AI can generate titles and classify tasks. Focus on describing what you want, not the details.
